The '''bageraset''' was a large, herbivorous herd animal native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was a distant cousin of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Falumpaset/Legends|Falumpaset]].

Bageraset meat was comestible. The cookbook ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed how to best cook that meat.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bagerasets appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
